source.note: Curated from the public TWiN profile. Public sites may be backed by public, source-available, or private repositories.

published.name: ARCANE OS
published.description: An AI-native operating environment for governed, accountable human–AI collaboration in high-trust and regulated settings.

published.name: Arcane OS SDK
published.description: A standalone SDK and CLI for building, testing, packaging, and managing Arcane applications inside or outside ARCANE OS.

published.name: Arcane Exchange
published.description: A wizard-space bazaar for Arcane applications, AI tools, public catalogs, and private portals.

published.name: Astrolabe
published.description: An interactive map that makes the TWiN ecosystem understandable across foundations, platforms, products, programs, audiences, funding, and native hosts.

published.name: DBOPFS
published.description: A browser-native database built on the Origin Private File System: tables become directories, records become files, and data stays local unless exported.

published.name: DBOPFS Studio
published.description: A Chromium workspace for exploring, editing, previewing, printing, and managing DBOPFS application data stored in OPFS.

published.name: SpellWire
published.description: A private, invite-only communications ledger for human-and-AI teams to exchange context, evidence, requests, and decisions.

published.name: Toshokann
published.description: A neutral foundation for organizing, retaining, finding, and sharing institutional knowledge as a library, archive, repository, or information-sharing home.

published.name: TWiN Compass
published.description: A moral, ethical, culturally aware, behavioral-health-informed layer that helps purpose-built models reason and communicate more safely.

published.name: KEMPO
published.description: A human-scored, 100-prompt evaluation of AI judgment across behavioral safety, ethics, cyber, crisis, and public-safety categories.

published.name: Sentinel
published.description: Provenance-first investigative intelligence that turns complex records into source-cited, human-reviewed leads and actionable reports.

published.name: Scamurai
published.description: A human-centered scam and abuse defense suite built around evidence, explanation, consent, and agency.

published.name: Redress
published.description: A source-grounded workbench for organizing records, tracing material claims to evidence, and preparing analysis, drafts, research, and hearings for human review.
